name: set_light
description: Turn a room light on or off; optionally set its brightness when the user specifies it.

on.description: True to turn on, false to turn off.

brightness.description: Optional brightness percentage, only when explicitly requested.

name: set_timer
description: Start a countdown timer for a duration in minutes; optionally label it.

label.description: Optional label, include only when the user names a label.

name: set_volume
description: Set the speaker volume to a percentage from 0 to 100.
